name: WP2 near-critical intervention confirmation
authorization: User: 进入 WP2; stop after WP2 report for user decision
status: prospective local lock; persist lock externally before calibration; not a public registry

hypotheses.primary: Mean node-exchange loss minus face-exchange loss, averaged equally across independently eligible cells, is positive; require positive means in all four families
hypotheses.secondary: Mean node-greedy loss minus face-exchange loss averaged across the same eligible cells is positive
hypotheses.motivation: Stronger interventions may amplify synergy near suppression; prior 8-graph signal was post hoc, not confirmation

graphs.ws: 6-neighbor ring, one-pass rewiring probability .15, original generator unchanged
graphs.sparse_sbm: two equal blocks; independent p_in=10/(n-1), p_out=2/(n-1)
graphs.pa_triadic: initial 4-clique; each new node has 3 distinct old targets: degree-proportional first target; subsequent with probability .5 uniformly among last target neighbors not yet chosen, otherwise degree-proportional among remaining old nodes
graphs.labels: independent uniform permutation after construction; prevents fixed historical target 0 being always a PA hub
graphs.faces: independent fill of each existing 3-clique, probability .6; synthetic groups, not observed interactions
graphs.replacement: no graph replacement or family exclusion based on density, history acceptance, calibration or confirmation outcomes

grid_scope: 8-cell full grid in k,D,beta2_scale; u=3 fixed to bound cost; no inference for u=6 or untested settings

histories.prehistory_law: original exact thinning history simulator; cell-specific beta values; total duration 3
histories.acceptance: endpoint has at least one R and one C; otherwise retry documented next attempt; retain all attempt initial/end states, memory and seeds
histories.across_cells: same topology, fresh cell-specific histories; dependence clustered by graph
histories.failure: if 10000 attempts exhausted, stop and report; no replacement or silent conditioning change

seeds.selection_remainder: same coordinates plus 91, independent of outcomes
seeds.sharing: action-common seeds within stage; common exchange seeds across policies; any repeated action+seed is reported as repeat, not independent sample

calibration.graph_weighting: equal graphs and balanced families; ratio of graph-averaged burdens, not mean of individual ratios
calibration.freeze: hash eligibility.json after ALL calibration cells complete, before ANY confirmatory trajectories
calibration.independence: separate root seeds, topologies and histories; no search or primary comparison on calibration
calibration.all_cells: confirm and report all 8 cells, even if ineligible; no grid extension based on results
calibration.no_eligible_cell: primary endpoint not estimable and gate fails; no substitute primary

selection.pool_rule: unchanged candidate_nodes: include R-degree k-set, then rank by degree*(1+R_indicator)+2*face_count, ID ties
selection.top_rdegree: all graph nodes: R indicator first, degree second, node ID last
selection.exchange_rule: unchanged single anchor, 13-set portfolio; node: anchor+12 singles; face: anchor+6 singles+6 face pairs, missing pairs filled with singles; at most two discovered finalists plus anchor; fresh holdout selects
selection.budget_accounting: NG1024; each exchange512 anchor+256 discovery+256 holdout. Shared anchor physically once. Physical per context=2560; standalone logical=3072. No double-addition of shared cost
selection.overhead: record full selection seconds, but WP2 is not an isolated timing benchmark
selection.search_noise: no safety or no-harm claim from the 256-rollout holdout

evaluation.sets: each distinct deployed k-set and empty set, exactly once per history; common new tapes
evaluation.loss: integral of rumor fraction over [D,D+H], unnormalized by H; smaller is better
evaluation.independence: final tapes disjoint from every selection stage

statistics.unit: graph; first average 3 histories per cell
statistics.primary_aggregate: equal-weight average over independently eligible cells within each graph, then equal graph average
statistics.main_correction: Bonferroni over 2 predeclared aggregate comparisons, two-sided alpha=.025 each, nominal family .05
statistics.cell_family: all 8 cells x 3 contrasts (FEX-NEX, FEX-NG, NG-Rdegree); separate descriptive Bonferroni family of 24, alpha=.05/24 each; no cellwise result can replace primary aggregate
statistics.bootstrap: 40000 percentile resamples, independently within each of 4 graph families, retain all histories/cells of resampled graph; numpy quantile method linear
statistics.family_intervals: descriptive pointwise 95%, same contrast seed; family means alone used for direction gate
statistics.point95: also report pointwise 95% for transparency; decision uses only adjusted intervals
statistics.sign_counts: graph means: positive >1e-12; negative <-1e-12; otherwise tie
statistics.gate: at least 1 eligible cell AND primary aggregate adjusted lower bound >0 AND each of 4 aggregate family means >0; secondary cannot rescue failed primary
statistics.no_stopping: fixed graph count and rollout counts, no interim effect inspection or optional stopping
statistics.limitations: bootstrap has nominal, not finite-sample exact coverage; new family/regime variation may exceed historical power input

power: 60 graphs planned for .025 absolute mean difference at approximate 80% normal power using historical SD .0615031, endpoint alpha=.025. This approximation excludes direction-gate loss and regime shift. 512 eval reps gives old graph MC fraction .0604; 1024 search budget retained to isolate proposed mechanism.

execution.checkpoint: atomic context outputs; reuse only matching protocol and source hash; deterministic retry only for operational interruption; record retries/cost separately if any
execution.raw_outputs: all selection losses/actions/seeds/diagnostics; shared anchor calls; independent evaluation losses; graph and all accepted/rejected historical endpoints; complete counts
execution.source_policy: unmodified original sources under vendor; new wrappers only; lock transitive source manifest
execution.failure_policy: NaN, invalid states or event cap raise error, no omission; algorithm fix after outcomes invalidates confirmation and requires reported deviation and new cohort

claim_decision: WP2 pass permits B only within calibrated range and fixed budget/pool; A requires WP3. Neither significance nor power establishes publication readiness.

preconfirmation_amendment.reason: Exact absorbing-rumor early termination to reduce computation, decided before any confirmation trajectories or calibration-effect summaries
preconfirmation_amendment.change: If current R count is zero, break proposal loop: with no R donor, all R reset rates vanish forever, so all remaining loss is exactly zero.
preconfirmation_amendment.unchanged: parameters, grid, graphs/seeds, hypotheses, budgets, statistics and eligibility rule
preconfirmation_amendment.calibration: retain v1 raw files unchanged; rerun under v2, require exact loss equality; count v1 calls as additional implementation validation/replay, never independent evidence
preconfirmation_amendment.diagnostics: proposal/update counts cover the realized prefix until rumor extinction; not full-horizon state trajectories; only scalar losses used
